Case note: CC/2665/2023
Client: Vandana Iyengar (nurse, Lucknow)
Opposing party: Sahyadri Constructions
Court: Lucknow District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
Filed on: 26/03/2023
Claim amount: Rs 4,76,00,000
Issue: consumer complaint. The flat was handed over with serious construction defects.
Advice given: Commission a structural audit report on the defects before the first hearing.
Outcome: The builder was ordered to repair the defects or pay their cost.
Recommended next step: Inspect the repairs before accepting them.
Witness: Vandana Menon
